headline: 10-foot python found on St. Martin's beach
summary: A massive python was discovered by locals on the shores of the island, drawing a crowd of curious onlookers.
details: A 10-foot-long python was found on the beach of St. Martin's Island, creating a stir among the local community and tourists.
The snake was discovered by locals who quickly gathered around to witness the unusual sight.
The python, measuring approximately 10 feet in length, was captured and held by several people in the image.
Local authorities or wildlife experts are typically contacted in such cases to ensure the safe relocation of the snake to a forest area.
